narrative: Delayed retest: Hacked contact sending free smartphone giveaway link.

message.body: Hey!! TechBrand is giving free smartphones for trial testing! Claim yours before stock runs out: http://techbrand-trial-giveaway.net

evidence.label: Request for Shipping Fee
evidence.value: Asks for ₹199 processing fee via credit card

evidence.label: TechBrand Official Website
evidence.value: Official website warns of fake trial giveaway link.

consequence_text.safe: You checked the official brand site and confirmed the trial giveaway was a scam.
consequence_text.unsafe: Paying processing fees for fake smartphone giveaways leads to financial loss.

teaching_point: Delayed retention: Free gadget giveaways requiring processing fees are phishing scams.
